title: Royal Chesterfield Bed – Button-Tufted Upholstered Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The Royal Chesterfield Bed is our value Chesterfield option. It has the same button-tufted headboard shape as our other Chesterfield designs, built to a lower price point without cutting corners on the frame or fabric quality. It is handcrafted in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Chesterfield button-tufted headboard and matching footboard
  • Handcrafted in the UK
  • Solid timber frame with a slatted base for support and ventilation
  • Optional ottoman gas-lift storage
  • Choice of Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen or Crushed Velvet

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £364.99; Small Double (4FT) £374.99; Double (4FT6) £389.99; King (5FT) £399.99; Super King (6FT) £389.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen or Crushed Velvet. Bespoke fabric and colour requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress or the Memory Foam Mattress.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales), made by our own team, and usually takes 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland delivery is £90. You have 14 days to return an unused, unassembled item in its original packaging, with free collection. A faulty item is replaced or fully refunded. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Is this the same as the Windsor Chesterfield Bed?

They share the classic Chesterfield button-tufted look. The Royal is our value Chesterfield option. Compare it with the Windsor Chesterfield bed if you are choosing between them.

Can I add ottoman storage?

Optional ottoman gas-lift storage is available. Contact us to confirm options for this design.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Can I see the fabric first?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can see the colour in your own light before ordering.

Browse the full range of Chesterfield beds to compare button-tufted designs.
